author_statement: I authorize execution of the Study 7E E1/E2/C0 held-out evaluation under S7E-AERC-HELDOUT-PLAN-001 using the frozen models in S7E-AERC-MODEL-FREEZE-001. This authorizes the 196-scenario / 784-decision scientific evaluation, validity/audit checks, and computation of the predeclared exact endpoints only. It does not authorize post-hoc model changes, PR #167 merge, manuscript/publication result claims, or any expansion beyond the frozen Study 7E protocol.
